_exemple_dossiers_dev: Empty by default: set e.g. ["C:/dev"] the day you want Jarvis to know about your code projects.
_aide_models_vocal: Models tried in this order for the PC voice assistant: fastest first. A saturated/slow model is skipped for a few minutes. Empty = same models as text messages.
_aide_voix_verif: Speaker verification. Inactive until voix/enregistrer-ma-voix-jarvis.bat has recorded your voice profile. mode: 'apprentissage' = logs scores to voix/ecoute_debug.log without blocking; 'strict' = ignores other voices. seuil: higher = stricter (0.35 to 0.8).
_aide_reveil: reveil_reponse: what Jarvis says right after waking up ("" = a simple beep). recherche_web_vocal:false = no web search for PC voice (faster); typed messages, Telegram and the app keep web search.
_aide_wake: wake_models: active wake words (custom-trained openWakeWord model). wake_seuils: sensitivity (lower = more sensitive, more false wake-ups).
_aide_speculatif: Faster replies: after speculatif_s seconds of silence, Jarvis starts thinking and preparing its voice while still waiting for the end of your sentence (fin_phrase_s). If you resume talking, it discards everything. speculatif:false to disable.
_aide_ecoute: attente_parole_s = seconds given to start speaking after the beep; fin_phrase_s = silence (seconds) that ends your sentence.
_aide_conversation: After its reply, Jarvis keeps listening without needing the wake word again. attente_s: time given to answer a question from Jarvis; attente_suite_s: time to keep going after a simple reply; question: optional fixed follow-up phrase; signal: 'bip' for short beeps, '' for silence. Also stops if you say 'no thanks'.
_aide_picovoice: Optional second wake word (Picovoice Porcupine). Paste your access_key and put your .ppn file in voix/picovoice/. Leave access_key empty to disable; the primary wake word stays active.
_aide_reponses_vocales: vocal = replies by voice when you spoke by voice; toujours = always; jamais = never
_aide_url_telephone: Tailscale address of this PC, e.g. https://my-pc.tailnet1234.ts.net
_aide_secours_prioritaire: Tries Groq BEFORE Gemini when true (useful if your Gemini quota is exhausted).
_aide_local: Last-resort fallback when both Gemini AND Groq are unavailable: local Ollama model (gemma3:4b). TEXT ONLY: its action tags are ignored by the code. actif:false to disable.
_aide_secours: Fallback AI if Gemini is unavailable (Groq, OpenAI-compatible). Leave key empty to disable.

entreprise.mentions_devis: Quote valid for 30 days. 30% deposit on order.

_aide_entreprise: Check VAT, stamp duty and mandatory mentions with your accountant (these defaults are France/Tunisia-specific examples).
_aide_entreprise_masnasoft: Optional second invoice issuer — used when a client comes from a specific lead source (here: AI-prospected leads), while the default `entreprise` above stays the issuer for everything else. Each issuer gets its own invoice numbering sequence, never mixed.
_aide_emploi: relance_jours: delay (in BUSINESS days, weekends excluded) after marking a job application as 'sent' before it shows up in the follow-up list. Computed from the actual send date, not the date the draft was written.
_aide_fac: Optional: credentials for a third-party schedule portal synced by fac.js (headless-browser automation, see README) into the agenda. Leave email empty to disable — nothing is attempted without it. semaines_avance: how many weeks ahead to read on each sync.
_aide_securite: dossiers_lecture / dossiers_ecriture: the only folders Jarvis can see / modify. exclusions_perso: path fragments that are always forbidden. exceptions: EXACT file paths you allow by hand here (Jarvis itself can never touch this file).
_aide_fenetre: Default window size (pixels) when Jarvis opens its own window; Edge refuses a width under ~516. coin: bas-droite/haut-droite/bas-gauche/haut-gauche/centre.
_aide_points: Spoken check-in every N hours between debut and fin (even on rest days). Logged in journal/. telegram:true = also send the check-in on Telegram.
_aide_interruption: Say the wake word WHILE Jarvis is talking to interrupt it: it listens right away. 'Continue' resumes exactly where it stopped. Anything else is treated as a new request. interruption_actif:false to disable (useful if the mic picks up its own voice from speakers and cuts itself off).
_aide_mail: Mail triage (Mail section): dedicated LIGHTWEIGHT Ollama model (qwen3:4b, ~2.5GB, smaller than gemma3:4b used for conversation) with a smaller context window: less RAM needed.
_aide_seo: SEO audit + prospecting tool (separately deployed, e.g. on Netlify): seo.url is the base used by the AUDIT_SEO and RECHERCHE_SEO actions. Read-only, no email is ever sent by this code.
_aide_agentsia: Business prospecting for a given product/service: RECHERCHE_ARTISANS searches the given trades/cities (or rotates through the configured list if none given by voice). Results without a findable email are discarded automatically. agentsIA.nuit: one silent automatic search per night, with a reminder after wake-up.
_aide_automatisation: api_key: your local n8n public API key (Settings > n8n API), used by AUTOMATISATION_CREER to create workflows — always created disabled (active:false), the code never turns them on itself.
